name: The Four Dukes
label: Quest
description: The Four Dukes: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The links between the Twilight's Hammer and the Abyssal Council are proving to be more important than we had expected.

We believe the elemental nobles known as the Abyssal Dukes are one of the primary force organizing the Twilight's Hammer cultists. Find a way to lure the four Abyssal Dukes into our plane of existence and destroy them!
Your dedication and prowess in past assignments have led us to choose you for this particular assignment. We are certain you will succeed in this endeavor.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is your task done yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have achieved a great accomplishment for our cause today, friend. You've vanquished some of our most powerful enemies. For that I greatly commend you.
